name: Ledanet
summary: Cairns ISP ('Cairns' Fastest Internet Service Provider'), expanding local-call access across the Atherton Tablelands and Douglas Shire by 1998. Acquired by Chariot Ltd (announced 11 May 2004) alongside Gold Coast-based Broadnet, part of Chariot's 12-ISPs-in-18-months consolidation; ledanet.com.au continued as a Chariot netconnect customer domain.

events.details: Existing as an ISP by 2 Dec 1998: ledanet.com.au captured by the Wayback Machine — 'Cairns' Fastest Internet Service Provider' — advertising chat-line service, time-balance checking, and new local-call access to the Atherton Tablelands (with Douglas Shire 'within 2 weeks').

refs.label: Wayback 2 Dec 1998: Ledanet - Cairns' Fastest Internet Service Provider

events.details: Acquired by Chariot Limited (AAP/SMH, 11 May 2004): 'The new additions to Chariot's stable are Cairns-based Ledanet and Gold Coast-based Broadnet', following 'its acquisition of 12 ISPs in Australia over the past 18 months'. Chariot MD Robert Horlin-Smith said the bolt-on acquisitions pushed Chariot toward its 150,000-customer target. ledanet.com.au persisted as a Chariot netconnect mail domain (webmail dropdown, Mar 2005 portal capture).
